feature_definitions.StockMom60_raw: Exact existing residual raw_return-beta*TOPIX; shift1 observation then rolling60 sum min60; original >20 absent exchange-session segmentation.
feature_definitions.Sector33Common_raw: Exact DM-20261002-08 self-inclusive equal-weight finite StockMom mean, same-date PIT33 join, minimum5 finite members; same unknown/missing policy.
feature_definitions.state: Exact raw A(++),B(+-),C(-+),D(--); exact zero/nonfinite ZERO_OR_MISSING. C evaluable coverage=joint finite raw, includes exact zeros.
feature_definitions.RAW_EWMA_CONTROL: StockMom60_raw, nonfinite neutral0 before EWMA(.25) to preserve finite-output/relisting policy; no Sector inputs or rank transform. Nonmissing values unchanged.
feature_definitions.RAW_EWMA_SHORT_VETO: Exact prior08 ShortVeto: joint-finite raw Stock>=0 or Stock<0/Common<=0 kept, C neutral0. Nonfinite raw context neutral0 before one EWMA(.25). No prior/post rank.
feature_definitions.EWMA: Existing per-Code/relisting segment smooth alpha=.25 adjust=False; sector changes preserve state. No second smoothing.
feature_definitions.interpretation: Transform-order matched operational contrast VETO-control within raw->EWMA only. Missingness neutralization remains an operational difference; matched-row diagnostics cannot erase past EWMA missingness.

selection_rule: VETO relative to RAW control: pooled NetSR>, EX2016 NetSR>; EX2016 annualNet>, Shortgross>=, Shortnet>=, turnover<=1.25x, Longnet>0, Qmonotonicity>0; 2011-2015 NetSR improvements>=4/5; EX2016 paired20session/2000rep/seed20261002 deltaNetSR CI95 lower>0; EX2016 deltaShortnet>0 and deltaShortgross/deltaShortnet>=.5. All required. Failure REJECT, success NEXT_EXPERIMENT_ELIGIBLE_TRAIN_ONLY. RAW control diagnostic only; no adoption inference vs MOM60.

diagnostics.replacement: RAW control vs Veto only; ShortQ1+Q2,Q1,Q2 REMOVED/ADDED/UNCHANGED. Save row target, signed gross/net/cost, weight contribution, stock/common quantiles and sector distributions. Shortgross difference exact sum; cost effect includes OTHER exit-only rows.
diagnostics.C_cohorts: RAW control C Shorts all/removed/retained, row count,target,annual gross/net,average signed and absolute weights,sector distribution; raw veto may persist in Short through EWMA.
diagnostics.state: Same A/B/C/D/ZERO attribution to globally ranked original books, equal-row/equal-date target, daily RankIC, side gross/net/cost/turnover. Full observed spells, censor flags, 1/5day uninterrupted persistence.
diagnostics.turnover: Total/side annual cost, C entry/exit share. Difference partition current rows C_STATE_EXIT (removed C Short, distinct from temporal C exit), REPLACEMENT (added Short), UNCHANGED_WEIGHT, REMOVED_NON_C, OTHER including exits. Overlap temporal C-entry/exit share separately; descriptive disjoint reconciliation, no unique delayed causal attribution.
diagnostics.long: Gross/net/turnover, membership retention and Jaccard vs RAW control (MOM60 reference also saved).
diagnostics.sector: Short33 exposure/dailyHHI/max, Q1/Q2 sector distributions,top2 exposure and sector signed contributions; no exclusion.
diagnostics.coverage: Stock finite vs Common finite vs C evaluable joint finite by year/33; RAW control raw requires Stock only. Output100% is separate.
diagnostics.matched_rows: Joint finite Stock/Common SAME rows for both final scores: daily RankIC and score-ranking Q1-Q5 diagnostic on matched rows; original full-book gross/net/turn/cost contributions on matched vs unavailable rows.
